text:
I'm sorry your plant is struggling. The standard guarantee runs **30 days** from delivery, so at 35 days a claim isn't covered unless you're a **Leafy Plus member**. Plus members get **90 days** on plants ordered while their membership was active.

If you were a Plus member when you ordered, you can claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back.

If you weren't a Plus member, the policy doesn't cover a claim, but a Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email to try to save it. Were you a Plus member when you placed the order?
